parts.official_mark_scheme_text: State the unsimplified term in $x^2$, or its coefficient, in $(1+3x)^{1/3}$: $\dfrac{(1/3)(-2/3)}2(3x)^2$ [B1]. Symbolic binomial coefficients are not sufficient for the B marks. State the unsimplified term in $x^3$, or its coefficient: $\dfrac{(1/3)(-2/3)(-5/3)}6(3x)^3$ [B1]. Multiply by $(3-x)$ to give two terms in $x^3$, or their coefficients [M1]. Printed guidance: $3\times\frac{10}{6}+1$; equivalently, $3\times($the $x^3$ coefficient$)-($the $x^2$ coefficient$)$ and no other term in $x^3$; ignore errors in terms other than $x^3$. Obtain answer $6$ [A1; not $6x^3$]. Total 4.
